steps.name: Click
steps.text: C'mon, over here!

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: The markings here... they look like they're simply venting.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Severin thought this was some kind of calculated sabotage. But was it, actually? This really does look like senseless violence.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Click, did you find something?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Sure did. But...

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Can you come here, GreyThroat? I... I don't know how to say this...

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: In that room...

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Your pupils are red again. Control yourself. Don't be afraid. Ayerscarpe, stay outside with her. Warn the mob.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Roger.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: In here?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: (It's a mess. Someone's last desperate stand... Ugh... are these... frozen limbs?)

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: (Wait, who is this?)

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Gah! She's a doctor?!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: If you don't leave, we'll kill you too!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: The solution I just sprayed on you is both volatile and toxic.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Wha?! Wh-what did you do to us?

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Out with it! Or I'll... I'll... Ugh...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: How do you feel?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Tell me where Biederman is and I'll give you the antidote. Or you can enjoy spending the next few hours vomiting between hallucination episodes.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: You're sick... I... I don't know... any Biederman. I just... have to kill all... the nobles... nng...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Then I'm afraid you're all going to stay in jail.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Huh? A mushroom? That's a big mushroom... Why is it... moving? Why is it biting?!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Schultz! We have more wounded! A lot of them! The insurgents took over the market and Maibaumplatz. But many more people are still trapped in Zwölftontechnik Strasse.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: They're unstoppable!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Once the fighting started, we lost all hope of stopping anything.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Now we face two possible outcomes: Surrender, or fight.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: What should we do?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Surrender, hand over the city to Reunion and the insurgents, and go starve to death in the snow.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: If we fight, both sides end up wounded or dead, and the survivors will starve to death in the snow.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Or...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: If casualties are unavoidable, we want the fewest possible—*cough* *cough*, *hack*—

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Ack... *cough* *cough* *cough*, *cough* *hack* *cough*—

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Schultz— Uncle? Uncle??

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Hey! Uncle, that's blood. You're coughing up blood!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Sorry! Just a second! Miss Tatjana!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: My uncle, he can't speak and—

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Are you okay? Abnormal breathing, lung lesions resulting in a loss of voice, this calls for... it calls for...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: What happened?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Mr. Severin, he's actually—

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: You should listen to the doctor and quit smoking. We don't need a test to see you have some serious persistent lung damage.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Let me see here... I need to take this off——

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Hey! Don't move!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: You... you're Infected?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: These are Oripathy symptoms. The Originium is pushing out from his lungs into his throat. This dark powdery substance below your throat... that's Originium crystals surfacing through your skin.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Your cells have begun fusing with the Originium. Is this why you don't care about your health?!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Did he get it from the battle just now?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: This isn't an early symptom or an acute lesion. He's been Infected for some time.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Probably from the Catastrophe... No, that's too recent. It must have been even before that.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: *Cough* *cough*——*cough* *cough* *cough*!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Black blood clots. Suzuran, take a sample.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Okay! Sorry, sir. I'll be quick.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: No way the hospital is functioning right now. Okay, take him into the town hall!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Wolumonde... can't be without... her Schultz!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: If you keep pushing yourself, she's definitely going to lose him.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: You... really look like a doctor right now.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: *Cough* cough*, *cough* *cough*—

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Phew, looks like I can talk for a minute after coughing up blood. Handy, that.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Tough guy.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I have a favor to ask.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Say your piece, but I'm taking you in. Lisa, hold him. Tatjana, help me lift.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Right!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Please, everyone, *cough* *cough*, don't tell anyone I'm Infected...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Then, I'll admit that I was the murderer who set the fire. I was the cause of all Wolumonde's problems...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: And what of the real killer?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I don't care. I can't.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: But at least... they'll have their scapegoat, and no excuse to keep fighting.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: But it's not enough... Without an external force strong enough to clamp down on them, they'll continue their cycle of revenge.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: So I request... Rhodes Island's assistance... Even though we can't afford to pay for it now.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: But if Wolumonde survives this disaster... we will repay you.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: We aren't a charity.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I'm begging you!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I don't have the authority to make promises on behalf of Rhodes Island. Saving a town of ten thousand people is beyond the scope of our mission, and way beyond the authority Amiya invested in me.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: But, for Atro, 'we' won't abandon Wolumonde.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Stand aside, we have a wounded—

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: GreyThroat? Why are you alone?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Suzuran, take the Schultz to the upstairs parlor. And don't let anyone see you.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Brutal as it may be, once he settles down, Schultz Severin is going to have to stand up and lead again.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Roger that! I'll take care of it!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Tatjana.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: There are riots all over town. People are getting hurt or killed. I... I can't just sit here.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: I'll go organize the militia that didn't get caught up in the riot. At least... at least I can do something.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Sure. Go ahead.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Thank you!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Can we talk?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: We found Biederman.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: We need to capture him immediately and end the riots, we have to avenge Atro—

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: No.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: He's dead.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: ...What?!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: We found him on the 'Gramophone' at coordinate B2.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: There were visible wounds on the back of his head, and ice crystals remained on the surface of his skin. All signs indicated an Arts attack.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: The operator on scene could not make an accurate determination, but wounds on the surrounding cadavers indicated that Biederman had died in the riot at least a few hours prior.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Biederman is dead. But the riots continue. We all know what that means.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Click and Ayerscarpe are searching his residence. Unless they run into trouble—

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Wait...! You said, you said he's already dead?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: If you really need me to repeat myself, yes, he is already dead.
I watched as the smile on Folinic's face froze— Yes, that smile.
The loss of Operator Atro left her emotionally unstable, until we learned about Biederman.
No longer troubled with issues of colonialism, the Infected, or class, she simply, and happily, found her revenge.
Does she feel some momentary relief? Relief at having realized her goal?
What next? How am I to deal with this new... condition of hers?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: So it is.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: A Contingency Contract operation agreement. Signed by one Catastrophe Messenger Biederman.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: So then, was it all part of the plan? Including your own death, Biederman?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Hm... but why? Could that Contingency thingamajig be the real mastermind?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Letting people die in a Catastrophe is not really their modus operandi. They wouldn't act in such a... brutal manner.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: But if he was helping the insurgents to try to save more lives...? Why?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Is this really going to save lives, at the end of the day? GreyThroat says Wolumonde is in a real bad spot right now.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: No. The Contingency Contract is just a platform.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: It is true that a small percentage of the Messengers using the Contingency Contract have a utilitarian obsession, leading them to 'save' as many people as possible.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Wolumonde had already suffered a Catastrophe. Could he have... set the fire to draw in outside forces to intervene...?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: I'm so glad Leonhardt and Rhodes Island's other Catastrophe Messengers don't get so mixed up with them.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: But... that can't be right... What if..

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Ayerscarpe!

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Look over there! By the music store! What's that weird thing?!

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: It's a... mountain?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: No. It's a big moving boulder?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Could it be that one guy's Arts?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: That isn't the kind of thing one man's Arts can do. Let's hurry back to the others!

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: There's no way an ordinary town militia is going to stand against a battle-hardened combat squad, and a Sarkaz one at that!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: What's that? An earthquake?

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Ah! It's that rock monster again! Quick! Start the 'Gramophone!'

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: They came! Reunion is here to liberate us!

steps.name: Armed Infected A
steps.text: Long live Reunion! Forward! Drive out the rotten nobles!

steps.name: Armed Infected B
steps.text: Long live Reunion!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Cover their retreat. Get back to the town center and activate the Gramophone. And stay safe!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Got it!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Tatjana, that one at the end of the street... do you know him?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Halt. At ease.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Yes. We are now just one step away.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: One step away from destroying this town.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: But there is no hope behind us. They cheer for liberation. But all we have freed is their anger and hatred. This is a typical, bloody invasion.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Is it? I don't really care. At this point, a happy ending is out of the question.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: This is the last chance... a chance to give them, before we take the last step.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: A chance to surrender?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: No... a chance to fight back. A chance to show conviction and let us stand in for the people... let us decide the winners and losers for ourselves.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: It's tough, thankless work, being a mercenary. Always the toughest. Never appreciated.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Whatever. It's your call.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Then—

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: —Arise, great boulder.
